Chegg is a student media learning platform offering services to universities and community colleges. The company also helps students become smarter, saves time & money. 

The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, USA.

aiResearchSummary.text: Chegg is researching automated testing materials in electronic document publishing, systems for managing recall activities with extended reality, and methods for providing personalized multimedia avatars for online education platforms. Additional areas include augmented reality mathematics in learning platforms, automatic speech signal processing using natural language processing, correlating jobs with personalized learning activities, document review management, gamified learning activities, and automated lecture deconstruction.
